import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from datetime import datetime
import math

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")


# Feature engineering function
def create_features(df, is_train=True):
    df = df.copy()

    # Parse datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])

    # Extract temporal features
    df["pickup_hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["pickup_dayofweek"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["pickup_month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["pickup_day"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day

    # Haversine distance
    def haversine_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
        R = 6371  # Earth radius in km
        phi1 = np.radians(lat1)
        phi2 = np.radians(lat2)
        delta_phi = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
        delta_lambda = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)
        a = (
            np.sin(delta_phi / 2) ** 2
            + np.cos(phi1) * np.cos(phi2) * np.sin(delta_lambda / 2) ** 2
        )
        c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))
        return R * c

    df["haversine_distance"] = haversine_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )

    # Manhattan distance
    df["manhattan_distance"] = np.abs(
        df["pickup_latitude"] - df["dropoff_latitude"]
    ) + np.abs(df["pickup_longitude"] - df["dropoff_longitude"])

    # Euclidean distance
    df["euclidean_distance"] = np.sqrt(
        (df["pickup_latitude"] - df["dropoff_latitude"]) ** 2
        + (df["pickup_longitude"] - df["dropoff_longitude"]) ** 2
    )

    # Center distance from NYC center
    NYC_LAT, NYC_LON = 40.7128, -74.0060
    df["pickup_center_distance"] = np.sqrt(
        (df["pickup_latitude"] - NYC_LAT) ** 2 + (df["pickup_longitude"] - NYC_LON) ** 2
    )
    df["dropoff_center_distance"] = np.sqrt(
        (df["dropoff_latitude"] - NYC_LAT) ** 2
        + (df["dropoff_longitude"] - NYC_LON) ** 2
    )

    # Interaction features
    df["passenger_distance"] = df["passenger_count"] * df["haversine_distance"]
    df["hour_distance"] = df["pickup_hour"] * df["haversine_distance"]

    return df


# Filter training data for NYC bounds and outliers
print("Filtering data...")
train_df = create_features(train_df, is_train=True)

# NYC bounds (approximately)
LAT_MIN, LAT_MAX = 40.5, 40.9
LON_MIN, LON_MAX = -74.3, -73.7

train_df = train_df[
    (train_df["pickup_latitude"] >= LAT_MIN)
    & (train_df["pickup_latitude"] <= LAT_MAX)
    & (train_df["pickup_longitude"] >= LON_MIN)
    & (train_df["pickup_longitude"] <= LON_MAX)
    & (train_df["dropoff_latitude"] >= LAT_MIN)
    & (train_df["dropoff_latitude"] <= LAT_MAX)
    & (train_df["dropoff_longitude"] >= LON_MIN)
    & (train_df["dropoff_longitude"] <= LON_MAX)
    & (train_df["fare_amount"] > 0)
    & (train_df["fare_amount"] < 500)
    & (train_df["passenger_count"] > 0)
    & (train_df["passenger_count"] <= 6)
]

print(f"Filtered train shape: {train_df.shape}")

# Sample a manageable subset for training (1M rows)
np.random.seed(42)
sample_size = min(1000000, len(train_df))
train_sample = train_df.sample(n=sample_size, random_state=42)

# Time-based split for validation (last 10% of time)
train_sample = train_sample.sort_values("pickup_datetime")
split_idx = int(len(train_sample) * 0.9)
train_data = train_sample.iloc[:split_idx]
val_data = train_sample.iloc[split_idx:]

print(f"Train size: {len(train_data)}, Validation size: {len(val_data)}")

# Define feature columns
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_longitude",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "haversine_distance",
    "manhattan_distance",
    "euclidean_distance",
    "pickup_center_distance",
    "dropoff_center_distance",
    "pickup_hour",
    "pickup_dayofweek",
    "pickup_month",
    "passenger_distance",
    "hour_distance",
]

X_train = train_data[feature_cols]
y_train = train_data["fare_amount"]
X_val = val_data[feature_cols]
y_val = val_data["fare_amount"]

# Prepare test data
print("Preparing test data...")
test_df = create_features(test_df, is_train=False)

# Filter test data for NYC bounds
test_df = test_df[
    (test_df["pickup_latitude"] >= LAT_MIN)
    & (test_df["pickup_latitude"] <= LAT_MAX)
    & (train_df["pickup_longitude"] >= LON_MIN)
    & (train_df["pickup_longitude"] <= LON_MAX)
    & (test_df["dropoff_latitude"] >= LAT_MIN)
    & (test_df["dropoff_latitude"] <= LAT_MAX)
    & (test_df["dropoff_longitude"] >= LON_MIN)
    & (test_df["dropoff_longitude"] <= LON_MAX)
]

X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_keys = test_df["key"]

# Train CatBoost model
print("Training CatBoost model...")
model = CatBoostRegressor(
    iterations=500,
    depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    loss_function="RMSE",
    eval_metric="RMSE",
    verbose=False,
    random_seed=42,
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=(X_val, y_val), use_best_model=True)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_predictions))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Generate test predictions
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_keys, "fare_amount": test_predictions})

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample predictions: {submission_df['fare_amount'].head()}")
